idPrefix.description: Card id prefix (APP -> APP-12). Default: initials of the repo name, e.g. my-app -> MA.

baseBranch.description: Branch that tasks merge into and gates diff against. Default: origin's HEAD, else main.

wipLimit.description: Maximum cards in in-progress, code-review and ux-review at once (wf claim). Env WF_WIP overrides.

timezone.description: IANA zone for card dates (created, started, done). Default: the system zone.

push.description: Whether the task skill pushes the base branch after a merge.

label.description: Name of the goal that cards with milestone: true count toward (board progress bar, ETA, wf stats).

gates.description: Quality gates for wf gates. All selected gates run in parallel.

cmd.description: Shell command, run with bash -c from the worktree root. Env: WF_BASE (diff base), WF_CHANGED (file listing changed paths).

when.description: Globs matched against changed files; the gate is skipped when none match. '*' crosses directories, '?' is one character, a trailing '/' means everything under it. Omit to always run.

fix.description: Command that fixes what the gate checks (formatters); run by wf gates --fix before the gates.

cache.description: Skip when the content of the 'when' paths (whole tree without 'when') and the command match the last PASS.

gatesCache.description: Global switch for the gate cache (stored in <git common dir>/workflow-gates-cache).

gatesTailLines.description: Lines of output shown per failing gate.

worktree.description: How wf wt-init makes a fresh git worktree runnable.

link.description: Dirs hardlink-copied from the main checkout (symlink fallback), e.g. node_modules, vendor.

copy.description: Files copied once when missing, e.g. .env.

setup.description: Commands run in the worktree after linking, in order.

ui.description: Whether the project has a UI. false makes the verifier use the nearest non-UI surface and the ux-critic skip.

dev.description: The LOCAL dev app the verifier and ux-critic drive.

url.description: Base URL of the running dev app.

login.description: How to sign in locally: seeded accounts and WHERE the dev credentials live (never the secret itself), or how to register a throwaway account.

check.description: Optional project command for cheap one-shot page checks, preferred over browser MCP steps.

docs.description: Docs agents treat as ground truth.

design.description: Design specs and briefs for the ux-critic.

spec.description: Product or build specs for the planner.

high.description: Paths that make a diff high risk (two reviews, owner review).

overnight.description: Unattended runner (wf night / wf run). Env vars of the same name in upper case override.

retries.description: Attempts per card; usage-limit waits and overload backoffs do not count.

model.description: Model for the headless manager sessions; a queue file's '# model:' line overrides.
